title: A Table for Radley
summary: Oswin Fleece says Radley Kettle is going short. 3 cheese wheels and a visit would help, before the first frost.
offer_text: "Radley Kettle will not ask, so I am asking for them. Go and see what is wanted, and bring cheese wheels before the first frost. The stock at the fold is the town's, and this is what it is for."
turn_in_text: "Thank you. It is the small things that keep a town."

objectives.text: Visit Radley Kettle and ask what is wanted
Take 3 cheese wheels from the fold
Hand the cheese wheels to Radley Kettle
